summary.text: Jordan Chessher is the Republican candidate for the Kansas House of Representatives, District 103, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democratic incumbent Angela Martinez.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has spent nearly twenty years in aviation manufacturing and quality control at Boeing and named child welfare, property tax relief and public safety among his priorities.

paragraphs.text: Jordan Chessher earned a high school diploma from Wichita Northwest High School and an associate degree from Cowley County Community College in 2008, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a husband and father of six who was born and raised in Wichita and still lives there.
Chessher advanced unopposed from the August 4, 2026 Republican primary, receiving 318 votes.
He said he works with Project Heaven and wants stronger accountability in child welfare and better support for families.
He also listed property tax relief for seniors and working families and practical, community-focused leadership among his three campaign messages.
